title: REQ · Scene character schema accepts optional dialogue or interaction
summary: characterSchema accepts an optional interaction (dialogue id and events) and still validates existing characters.
description: Context: characterSchema has no way to attach dialogue or interaction to an NPC. Desired behavior: add an optional interaction object { dialogue?: string, events: event[] } so NPCs can open a dialogue node or fire events from data. Expected result: characters without interaction still parse unchanged. Why: lets NPCs be authored purely in scene data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character with interaction { dialogue: 'greet' }, When sceneSchema parses it, Then the parsed character has interaction.dialogue 'greet' and events [].
Given a character without interaction, When sceneSchema parses it, Then it passes and interaction is undefined.
Given an interaction whose dialogue is a number, When parsed, Then a path-tagged error mentions characters.0.interaction.dialogue.
